state:
**Goal `ext-image`, Stage 2 (the build): the image component is embedded, typed into every compile, and callable with no `nvs.toml`; the libwebp leg is not started.** The design is settled by ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; no session re-decides one.

`nvs_ext::load::builtin_manifests` reads the built-in manifests without an engine, and `crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` `with_built_in` puts them in front of the entries' manifests in `front_end_in`, so every compile (run, test, serve, check, bundle) resolves `Novis\Image\Codec`. A call no loaded entry answers reaches `built_in`, which makes the loader once per process (in the artifact cache of the first caller's configuration) and runs `Builtin::extension`. `nvs run` and `nvs test`'s `#[Test]` suite now always install a `Calls`, over an empty set when there is no `[[extension]]`; `nvs serve` already installed one. How it works is the module doc of `crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs` and the rule fragment's *Partly on disk*.

Green in Stage 2: `tests/conformance/novis/image-info-answers-with-no-configuration.nvst`, the four `crates/nvs-ext/tests/builtin.rs` tests, and the `env_hash` check. Still red: the `webp-lib` tool and its test, `--check-c-deps` for libwebp, and the attribution test.

items.text: **The libwebp tool** (`rule:packaging/a-prebuilt-wasm-library-is-rebuilt-in-ci`) — `tools/nv/cmd/webp-lib.ts` with `--check` (prints `libwebp: the committed library matches its recorded digest`), shaped like `tools/nv/cmd/gen-attribution.ts:274`; it builds under WSL with wasi-sdk into `extensions/image/` beside a `SOURCE.json` holding the source tarball's pinned digest and the library's digest. Whether wasi-sdk is installed under WSL on this machine is not checked; if it is not, name the install in the handoff.

**The tool's test** — `tools/nv/test/webp-lib.test.ts`: a library whose bytes differ from its record fails the check, and a source tarball whose digest differs from the pin is refused (the record's `webp-lib-refuses-a-library-or-a-source-that-differs` names both test titles), shaped like `tools/nv/cmd/gen-attribution.ts:274`.

**libwebp in the C-dependency ledger and the notice** (`rule:packaging/a-c-dependency-answers-two-questions`) — `bun nv gen-attribution --check-c-deps` names libwebp as `inside the image component`, and `tools/nv/test/attribution-extensions.test.ts` holds that the notice carries every crate the built-in components link and libwebp's licence; the ledger is read at `tools/nv/cmd/gen-attribution.ts:274`.
